source: User supplied Poco X7 Pro report, 2026-10-12 20:25 America/Monterrey; not measured by the agent.

scopes.cpu: Android Process.getElapsedCpuTime milliseconds or Linux utime+stime ticks; this process/all threads, 100% one-core = one busy core. Total denominator logical_cores; not CPU frequency weighting or other apps.
scopes.frame_pacing: Monotonic wall intervals between process callbacks, includes scheduling/vsync. Callback FPS/current sample and recent 600-frame FPS use explicit windows. Godot FPS has its own once-per-second window.
scopes.gpu_lie: Last measured LIE compute timestamp interval, not GPU utilization; cached frames do not reconstruct.
scopes.gpu_memory: Vulkan allocator/requested LIE buffers; can overlap system RAM. Do not add to PSS/RSS.
scopes.pss: Android Debug.getPss proportional resident KiB converted to bytes; shared pages attributed proportionally, not RSS. Peak is max observed samples, not OS high-water mark.
scopes.rss: Linux process resident pages, not available in Android API mode.
scopes.unsupported: -1 or null = unavailable/waiting, never zero load.
